scope: Actual published default TypeScript Temporal namespace versus temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 basic ISO/Gregorian implementation and @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1. Same 48 public workloads retained from previous facade benchmark. TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar arithmetic/data, host Intl Umm al-Qura and named timezones. method: Eight varying inputs, output parity checked before timing, 20000 warmup, 9 samples x 50000 calls; transition-specific counts retained. Selected profile: typescript. Prefer isolated profiles for comparisons. Checksum consumes outputs. Size uses esbuild es2022 minification and gzip level9; export-all TS consumer and reference namespace consumers. Profiling runs are separate from production timings.
changes: Shared arithmetic calendar-to-epoch conversion uses Gregorian month prefixes after validation, avoiding repeated month-length scans. Original25 native matrix retained; seven named-zone cases added separately with full signed output parity.
